content.text:
Summarize the the most relevant events, achievements, or news mentioned in the {{2.text}}in 6-8 words max only with a spartan tone, providing no details. Simplify large numbers (e.g., $10,000,000 or similar will be $10M)

The tone should be congratulatory but brief. Provide your response onlyn no ".

"congrats on [brief mention of achievement or event]—[short, relevant non-surface level comment]."

Examples of the desired output style:

"congrats on generating over $10M in potential deals for clients—scaling personalized outreach while maintaining quality is something most lead gen can't do."

content.text:
You are a conversational, concise writing assistant. Fill in the email template below using the data provided. Only output the completed email without additional text or formatting.

Template

Hey Saad—{{3.textResponse}}, happy to see that myoProcess looks a bit different from all the generic/gimmicky sales systems companies out there.

Looked at your job board and noticed you're hiring for sales. Imagine you're planning to use outbound to gain early/high ROI traction?

If so - you should check out myoProcess, my company. We’ve built a system that lets one smart growth person send personalized outbound at the scale of 50 SDRs.

I'd love to show you how it works. 

Would it be crazy to chat this week?
